extraction_warnings: Several fields (age, sex ratios, exact demographic breakdowns) are referenced as being in supplementary Table S1, which was not included in the provided text, so exact values could not be extracted.
Sequencing platform model (e.g., HiSeq/MiSeq) not specified beyond 'Illumina platform'.
PMID field populated from the external paper_id rather than in-text citation, since no PMID is stated in the body text.
study_name field does not match the canonical naming convention example given in the schema; the cohort name 'Kailuan study' was used as the closest available identifier.
Batch 1 subgroups ['Healthy control', 'Pre-hypertension', 'Hypertension'] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.

This paper focuses on gut microbiota and hypertension; most schema fields (zygosity, tumor staging, neonatal, obgyn, HLA, dietary restriction, disease response/RECIST) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.
Specific numeric values for age and BMI are referenced qualitatively but likely reported only in supplementary Table S1, which was not included in the provided text.
fmt_role and fmt_id fields apply only to the small subset of 3 human FMT donors, not the main 196-subject cohort; granularity mismatch noted.
smoker and antibiotics_current_use fields were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than directly stated status labels; confidence set to medium.

Actual measured values for clinical biomarkers (BMI, FBG, TC, TG, LDL, and mean SBP/DBP per group) are reported only in supplementary Additional file 1: Table S1, which was not included in the provided text; only diagnostic threshold ranges for SBP/DBP used for group classification could be extracted.

The study includes both human participants (Kailuan cohort) and germ-free mice (fecal transplantation recipients); the host_species field reflects the primary human cohort, but this is a dual-species study.

No schema field explicitly captures cohort/country-level metadata, disease grouping thresholds, or animal experiment details; some of this information was placed in 'uncurated_metadata' as a best-fit.
